nodes.label: Judie
nodes.rationale: Local environment assistant for tablet-style room control; not a chatbot. Commands are parsed deterministically — no LLM is required.

nodes.label: Deterministic Command Parsing
nodes.rationale: Commands are parsed deterministically so no LLM is required; Judie is a local environment assistant rather than a chatbot.

nodes.label: Local Tablet State Until Hardware Connected
nodes.rationale: Indoor climate and the music queue are local to this tablet until a sensor or player is connected — intentional so the UI does not pretend to be wired to hardware that is not there.
nodes.norm_label: local tablet state until hardware connected

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi 3
nodes.rationale: Pi 3 has only 1 GB RAM and a weak GPU; build and install on the Pi itself or any Linux aarch64 machine.

nodes.label: Pi Mode
nodes.rationale: Auto-enabled on low-RAM / ARM Linux: disables blur and heavy gradients, shortens motion, lighter status polling.

nodes.label: Prefer deb over AppImage
nodes.rationale: Prefer deb install over AppImage on Pi 3 for slightly less overhead.

nodes.label: Widget Creator
nodes.rationale: The editor is optional; Judie only needs a valid definition in the custom widget library or a valid JSON file.

nodes.label: Percentage Coordinates
nodes.rationale: Every element uses percentages of that size's inner face (origin top-left) so layouts scale across grid sizes independently.

nodes.label: Descriptor
nodes.rationale: descriptor and hook never appear on the home screen; they exist so a size can be wired to live data later.
